description: Use when you need to read base64 as text. Decodes standard base64 to UTF-8 text and refuses anything that is not valid base64 or not valid UTF-8, rather than guess. $0.01 USDC on Base per answer via x402; a refusal is free.

text.description: Base64 that decodes to UTF-8 text: the letters A to Z and a to z, the digits 0 to 9, + and /, then one or two = of padding at the end, which may be left out but, when given, must make the length a multiple of four. A length that leaves one character over a multiple of four is refused. White space anywhere is ignored and not counted in the length. At most 1,048,576 bytes of UTF-8, white space included.

name: decode-base64-to-text
title: Decode base64 to text
